title: Reproductive mode, but not rarity, influences population trajectories in corals: derived data and analysis code
description:
Derived datasets from three long-term coral reef monitoring programs in the US Virgin Islands (the USVI Territorial Coral Reef Monitoring Program, the National Park Service South Florida/Caribbean Network program in the Virgin Islands, and the California State University Northridge program at St. John), arborescent octocoral colony density surveys from St. John, and all analysis code (R scripts and Quarto files) used for data processing, statistical analyses, and figure generation for Olinger et al., "Reproductive mode, but not rarity, influences population trajectories in corals" (submitted to Science).

This archive is a snapshot of the GitHub repository that builds the companion website, https://reprovsrarity.reefcode.org, which shows the analysis as published and as a version that re-runs as monitoring data are added. Each GitHub release creates a new version of this record; the concept DOI always resolves to the latest version.
